title: Cyber Snake: Neon Overdrive
description: Navigate a glowing neon serpent through the digital matrix. Collect power nodes to grow longer while avoiding self-collision and boundary walls.
instructions: Swipe or use Arrow Keys / WASD to steer. Collect nodes to score.
author: Neon Arcade Community

title: Neon Blocks: Cyber Tetris
description: Fast-paced cyberpunk block puzzle. Rotate and fit falling polyominoes to clear full data lines before the memory buffer overflows.
instructions: Tap buttons or use Arrow keys: Left/Right to move, Up to rotate, Down to soft drop, Space for hard drop.
author: Neon Arcade Community

title: Space Invaders: Matrix Defense
description: Defend the mainframe against waves of descending alien data packets. Take cover behind defense shields and blast the invaders.
instructions: Use Arrow keys or on-screen D-Pad to move, Space or Action button to fire.
author: Neon Arcade Community

title: Cyber Breakout: Neon Brick Breaker
description: Shatter encrypted data bricks using an energy orb deflected by your cyber paddle. Clear all layers to decrypt the core.
instructions: Touch/drag paddle or move mouse/Arrow keys Left and Right.
author: Neon Arcade Community

title: Pong 2099: Cyber Rally
description: High-speed kinetic cyber pong against an adaptive AI core. Angle your returns to score points and outsmart the machine.
instructions: Touch and drag your paddle or move mouse/Arrow keys to deflect the ball.
author: Neon Arcade Community

title: 2048: Cyber Matrix Edition
description: Slide identical numerical data tiles to merge them into higher values. Reach the coveted 2048 core node to trigger quantum supremacy.
instructions: Swipe in any direction or use Arrow keys / WASD to shift tiles.
author: Gabriele Cirulli / Open Source Community

title: Hextris: Hexagonal Pulse
description: Fast-paced hexagonal puzzle game inspired by Tetris. Rotate the central hexagon to match 3 or more blocks of the same color.
instructions: Tap Left/Right screen halves or use Arrow keys / A & D to rotate the hexagon.
author: Hextris Team (Logan Engstrom, Garrett Finucane)

title: Minesweeper: Core Defusal
description: Locate and neutralize explosive data mines across the sector grid using numerical telemetry hints.
instructions: Tap to reveal cell, long-press or tap MODE to toggle warning flags. On desktop, left-click to reveal and right-click to flag.
author: Neon Arcade Community

title: Memory Matrix: Neural Match
description: Exercise your visual memory by pairing matching cybersecurity glyphs hidden within encrypted memory nodes.
instructions: Tap any two cards to reveal their glyphs. Match all 8 pairs with the fewest attempts.
author: Neon Arcade Community

title: Word Cipher: Neural Guess
description: Crack the 5-letter security code in six attempts or fewer. Colored feedback tiles indicate character accuracy and position.
instructions: Type letters using physical keyboard or tap on-screen keys. Press ENTER to submit code.
author: Katherine Yang (octokatherine)

title: Cyber Runner: Neon Rooftops
description: Sprint across skyscraper rooftops in a dystopian cyberpunk metropolis. Leap gaps and slide under deadly security barriers.
instructions: Tap upper screen or Up Arrow / W / Space to jump; tap lower screen or Down Arrow / S to slide.
author: Neon Arcade Community

title: Clumsy Bird: MelonJS Flight
description: Guide the melonJS avian drone through vertical obstacle gates in this open-source community tribute.
instructions: Tap screen, click mouse, or press Spacebar to flap wings and gain altitude.
author: Ellison Leão / melonJS

title: Flappy Drone: Cyber Escape
description: Navigate a rogue surveillance drone through narrow laser apertures inside the central server complex.
instructions: Tap screen or press Space / Up Arrow to thrust drone upwards.
author: Neon Arcade Community

title: Tic-Tac-Toe: Quantum XO
description: Challenge an AI neural network in classic 3x3 quantum grid alignment. Choose between AI Battle or Local 2-Player mode.
instructions: Tap any vacant grid node to deploy your quantum mark. Align 3 in a line to trigger victory.
author: Neon Arcade Community

title: Klondike Solitaire
description: The timeless single-player card challenge. Build the four suit foundations from Ace to King using alternating-color tableau stacks.
instructions: Tap or drag cards to stack descending alternating colors. Double-tap or double-click to auto-move to foundations.
author: Aashish Chakravarty

title: Mahjong Solitaire
description: Match and eliminate identical pairs of open tiles across multi-layer traditional layouts until the board is completely cleared.
instructions: Click or tap two matching open tiles (unblocked on top and at least one side) to clear them.
author: ScriptRaccoon
